cards.title: Why it works
items: Seats share no context: pinned aliases plus a free seat, so agreement means independent eyes, not a shared echo
The synthesis seat must state dissent explicitly — unanimity is reported, never assumed
Model binding lives in the graph bytes, so who judged what is recomputable, not remembered

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes: {{agents}} seats fan-in to synthesis; run_context seeds artifact + question + focus
Seat payloads are schema fences; synthesis merges with per-seat attribution and a dissent field
